entry.title: New: Resolution 139 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI DEPARTMENT OF BUSINESS, ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND TOURISM

Allows for the receipt of $1,500,000 of federally-derived funds for the development of the Kukuiola Permanent Supportive Housing Project in Kailua- Kona.
